returns.value: The `msg.value` in the call to the World contract before the World routed the call to the WorldContextConsumer contract.

returns._0: The address of the World contract that routed the call to this WorldContextConsumer.

params.interfaceId: The ID of the interface in question.

returns._0: True if the interface is supported, false otherwise.
